name: QuoteCraft: Quotes & Stories
title: QuoteCraft: Quotes & Stories
headline: Create quote photos, multi-screen video stories, callouts, and creator art.
description: QuoteCraft is the simplest, most versatile photo creator, quote overlay studio, and animated video story maker for Android. Turn everyday photos, camera captures, and vivid color canvases into eye-catching quote graphics, inspirational posters, and multi-screen video stories with calm relaxing background music.
